name: rpc-operation-v1
notes: Normalized operation IR shared by api-docs, ores-stack, ores-cli and generated Rust/Go/Dart/TypeScript/Gleam RPC clients. handlers.rs owns the semantic operation; route.rs/HTTP metadata are optional projections. Optional stream metadata is language-neutral; absence preserves legacy unary semantics. The same pair also carries the payload-free RPC error-logging declarations (OresTraceId, OresRoutineId, RpcErrorTransport, RpcDispatchOutcome, RpcErrorKind, RpcErrorLogEvent); tjsv.mapping.json scopes TJSV comparison to those declarations until the older RpcOperation declarations are brought to parity.
